pr_summary: The LSST error model class was relocated from rail.creation.degraders.lsst_error_model to rail.creation.degraders.photometric_errors. The fix updates import statements in example Jupyter notebooks and YAML pipeline configuration files to use the new module path, preventing ImportError when users run examples or load pipeline configurations.
environment_management: pip with optional conda support via environment.yml
special_system_dependencies: jax/jaxlib (may require GPU for full functionality)
patch_file_cues: Affected files: 4 Jupyter notebooks, 2 YAML configuration files
Notebook Python version metadata also updated (3.11.4 -> 3.10.0 in some files)
test_file_cues: Test verifies all RAIL stages can be imported correctly
platform_constraint_evidence: GitHub Actions CI runs on ubuntu-latest
pyproject.toml specifies Operating System :: OS Independent
No Windows or macOS specific dependencies or configurations detected
Project uses standard Python packaging with pip/setuptools
notes: This is a Python project (pz-rail) for astronomical photometric redshift data processing. The LSSTErrorModel class has been relocated to a new module. The fix.patch updates 7 files (4 notebooks and 2 YAML files) to use the new import path. The project relies on pz-rail-base as a core dependency. Testing is done via pytest. The CI workflow runs on Ubuntu with Python 3.10 and 3.11. The project has optional dependencies for various algorithms (algos), Jupyter notebooks (nb), and development (dev). Special system dependencies include MPI-enabled packages (mpi4py, hdf5, h5py) which may require conda for easier installation.
